items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: when you worked with them? ... Jack used to care of mute all the time. And sometimes we had to tell him about it.

ctx.x: Well, some of them don't do nothing but a whole lot of noise, you know. A whole lot of noise. They like that. Sing. But rather sound, you know. All kinds of sound. That's what the public like.
Did they use many mute to note bands like Jack Carrier's band when you worked with them?

They sometimes. Just sometimes. Sometimes. Jack used to care of mute all the time. And sometimes we had to tell him about it. Sometimes he used to get mad with me too. I said, what you care for? Well, he'd get to play sometime. I said, you could leave that mute home.
